validations.no_validation_reason: Introductory continuation screen; no respondent-data validation beyond the unstructured continue control is supported.

rules.description: Accept only the documented mutation-status responses.
Require an answer to the mutation-status question.
Accept only whole-number child ages from 0 through 30.
Require the child age response.
Accept only the seven documented care-journey responses.
Require one care-journey response.
Require the first treatment recall entry.
Validate the treatment recall open-end responses.
Accept only the five documented familiarity ratings for each treatment.
Require a familiarity rating for each displayed treatment.
Accept only the four documented treatment-use status codes for each treatment.
Require a treatment-use status for each displayed treatment.
Accept only the documented five treatment-satisfaction ratings.
Validate the satisfaction-reason open-end response when the question is displayed.
Accept only the five documented overall-impression ratings for each displayed treatment.
Validate the explanation open-end for each very-positive treatment shown.
Validate the explanation open-end for each very-negative treatment shown.
Validate the treatment-consideration multi-response selection.
Accept only the documented treatment options.
Validate the follow-up explanation when at least one treatment is selected.
Validate the treatment-concern open-end response where applicable.
Validate the select-all caregiver-advice responses.
Accept only the documented five preparedness ratings.
Validate the explanation of appointment preparedness.
Validate the select-all appointment-preparation responses.
Validate the open-end response for the something-else option.
Validate the select-all emotions response.
Accept only the three documented doctor-discussion outcomes.
Require one doctor-discussion outcome.
Validate the answer-specific explanation open-end.
Accept only the documented five comfort ratings for each grid column.
Require a comfort rating for each displayed topic.
Validate the select-all comfort-support responses.
Accept only the documented support-resource response codes.
Validate the select-all information-source responses.
Accept only the documented information-source codes.
Validate the something-else information-source explanation.
Require a first information-source selection from the dynamically inserted Q16 responses.
Validate the materials-and-resources multi-response selection.
Validate the descriptions of materials received from providers.
Validate the spontaneous OJEMDA association open-end response.
Validate the three topic-specific OJEMDA knowledge open ends.
Validate that Q20 is applicable when Q5.r9 is at least 2.
Validate the open-ended response format for questions about OJEMDA.
Validate that Q21 is applicable when Q5.r9 is at least 2.
Allow only the stated 1-to-5 comparison scale values.
Validate that Q22 is applicable when Q6.9 equals 1 or 2.
Validate the multi-response structure for Q22.
Allow only the listed Q22 response codes 1 through 10.
Validate that Q23 is applicable when Q22 equals 8.
Validate the open-ended explanation of why OJEMDA was not pursued.
Validate the open-ended explanation of the biggest reason selected.
Validate the open-ended description of drivers for pursuing OJEMDA.
Allow only the two stated discussion-origin response codes.
Validate the multi-response structure for reasons that kept the respondent from asking about OJEMDA.
Allow only the listed Q32 response codes 1 through 10.
Validate the multi-response structure for Q33.
Enforce the instruction to select up to three responses.
Allow only the listed Q33 response codes 1 through 9.
Validate the open-ended description of the child’s OJEMDA experience.
Validate that Q26 is applicable when Q6.9 equals 1 or 2.
Allow only the stated 1-to-5 likelihood scale values.

warnings: Q4 specifies a minimum of two characters for each open-end response, but the available rule schema has no typed text-length parameter; the open-end check is therefore emitted without that threshold.
Q6 explicitly defines a real-time warning when more than one treatment is currently used, but the supplied schema cannot represent a count-based trigger without inventing row variables.

Q8, Q9, Q10, and Q15-Q19A contain conditional routing text, but no existing filter variables or sufficiently row-specific structured predicates were supplied; uncertain conditional rules were omitted.
Exclusive-option logic is described for Q11 and Q28 and implied for Q15 and Q18, but exclusive binary variable names were not supplied; exclusivity rules were omitted rather than invented.

Q22 explicitly identifies exclusive options, but the canonical questionnaire supplies only the base variable and does not provide distinct exclusive response variables; no exclusive-answer rule was emitted.

Several routing statements use OR conditions or dynamic inserted responses without a safely representable structured predicate; corresponding uncertain routing rules were omitted for Q23A, Q31, Q24, Q32, Q33, and Q25.
notes: Open-ended checks validate the stated response format but do not impose mandatory completion because these questions are explicitly conditionally routed and marked not required.
